```{r}
# Modify patient ID
patient_id <- function(pid) {
  m <- str_match(pid, "^CAR-(\\d+)$")
  n <- as.integer(m[,2])
  ifelse(!is.na(n),
         paste("CAR", n, sep = "-"),
         NA_character_)
}
setwd("~/Documents/Other_project/CART_microRNA")
cart_mat <- read_xlsx("data/filtered_mirna.xlsx")
cart_mat <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(cart_mat)))
colnames(cart_mat) <- cart_mat[1, ]
cart_mat <- cart_mat[-1, ]
cart_mat <- cart_mat[order(rownames(cart_mat)), ]

data <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "data/cart_updated_clinical_covariates.xlsx")
data <- data[!is.na(data$OUTCOME_12M__PDSD1), ]
data <- data[, -c(30:36, 38:43)]

data$ID <- patient_id(data$ID)
data <- data[order(data$ID), ]
# sex F = 1, M = 0
data$SEX[data$SEX=="F"] <- "1"
data$SEX[data$SEX=="M"] <- "0"
# histology PMBCL = 0, LBCL = 1, MCL = 2
data$AF_ISTOLOGIA[data$AF_ISTOLOGIA=="PMBCL"] <- "0"
data$AF_ISTOLOGIA[data$AF_ISTOLOGIA=="LBCL"] <- "1"
data$AF_ISTOLOGIA[data$AF_ISTOLOGIA=="MCL"] <- "2"
data$AF_ISTOLOGIA <- as.numeric(data$AF_ISTOLOGIA)

is_na <- data[ , apply(data, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x)))]
is_na <- as.data.frame(is_na)
is_na <- is_na[, apply(is_na, 2, function(x) sum(is.na(x)) <= 1)]
is_na <- is_na[, 4:6]

data <- data[ , apply(data, 2, function(x) !any(is.na(x)))]
data <- cbind(data, is_na)
data <- data[-26, -c(3, 8, 14, 18,21)]

# Follow up 12 months 
cart_mat <- cart_mat[rownames(cart_mat) %in% data$ID, ]

data <- cbind(data, cart_mat)
data$selection <- paste(data$PRODOTTO, data$OUTCOME_12M__PDSD1, sep = "_")
data$PRODOTTO[data$PRODOTTO == "Axicel"] <- "0"
data$PRODOTTO[data$PRODOTTO == "Tisacel"] <- "1"
data$PRODOTTO <- as.numeric(data$PRODOTTO)

data$PRELD_HEMATOTOX_LOW01_HIGH2[data$PRELD_HEMATOTOX_LOW01_HIGH2=="HIGH >= 2"] <- "2"
data$PRELD_HEMATOTOX_LOW01_HIGH2[data$PRELD_HEMATOTOX_LOW01_HIGH2=="LOW 0-1"] <- "1"
data$PRELD_HEMATOTOX_LOW01_HIGH2 <- as.numeric(data$PRELD_HEMATOTOX_LOW01_HIGH2)
```

# Train/Validation/Test sets

```{r}
split <- function(data) {
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = data$selection, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  ll <- list(discovery = data[inTrain, ], test = data[-inTrain, ])
  return(ll)
}

train_valid <- function(discovery){ 
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = discovery$selection, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  train <- discovery[inTrain, ]
  train$ID <- NULL
  train$selection <- NULL
  
  valid <- discovery[-inTrain,]
  valid$ID <- NULL
  valid$selection <- NULL
  
  ll <- list(train = train, valid = valid)
  return(ll)
}

set.seed(333)
split1 <- split(data)

split2 <- replicate(100000, train_valid(split1$discovery), simplify = FALSE)
train <- lapply(1:100000, function(i) split2[[i]][[1]])
valid <- lapply(1:100000, function(i) split2[[i]][[2]])
```

# Elastic net

```{r}
set.seed(333)
foldid <- sample(rep(seq(5), length.out = nrow(train[[1]][,-21])))
elastic_net <- function(train, foldid) {
  cv <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(train[, -21]), train[, 21], family =  "binomial", foldid = foldid, alpha = 0.3)
  return(cv)
}

cv_glmnet <- lapply(train, function(x) elastic_net(x, foldid))

accuracy_dist <- function(cv_glmnet, valid) {
  pred <- as.data.frame(predict(cv_glmnet, newx = as.matrix(valid[, -21]), type = "response", s = "lambda.min"))
  pred$lambda.min[pred$lambda.min >= 0.5] <- 1
  pred$lambda.min[pred$lambda.min < 0.5] <- 0
  
  y_real <- valid$OUTCOME_12M__PDSD1
  y_pred <- pred$lambda.min
  
  tab <- table(factor(y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y_pred, levels= 0:1))
  accuracy <- (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2]) / (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2] + tab[1, 2] + tab[2, 1]) 
  return(accuracy)
}

valid_accuracy <- mapply(function(x, y) accuracy_dist(cv_glmnet = x, y),
                         cv_glmnet, valid)
summary(valid_accuracy)
hist(valid_accuracy)

coef_ll <- function(cv_glmnet) {
  coef <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_glmnet, s = "lambda.min")))
  coef$var <- rownames(coef)
  coef <- coef[abs(coef$s1) > 0, ]
  coef <- coef[-1, ]
  coef <- as.data.frame(coef$var)
  return(coef)
}
df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, lapply(cv_glmnet, function(x) coef_ll(x))))
df <- as.data.frame(table(df))
df <- df[order(df$Freq, decreasing = TRUE ), ]
colnames(df) <- c("var", "times")
df$freq <- 100*round(df$times/length(cv_glmnet), 2)
df$type <- as.character(df$var)
df$type[grep("hsa", df$var)] <- "mirna"
df$type[df$type != "mirna"] <- "clinic"
df <- df[df$freq >= 10,]

ggplot(df, aes(x=reorder(var, freq, decreasing = TRUE), y=freq, fill=type)) + 
  geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL) + theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), text=element_text(size=10))
```
